name: hxcpp_jit_r
description: Compile C++ at runtime from a hxcpp application and call it directly. C++ source is scanned for signatures, built into a cached module and exposed to Haxe as functions, globals, structs, arrays and strings, with callbacks, hot reload and a REPL-style session.
releasenote: 1.0.1: compile and call C++ from a hxcpp application while it runs. Plain C++ source is scanned for signatures, built into a cached module and exposed to Haxe as functions, globals, structs, arrays and strings.
